title: Construct a uniform BCH code at target-scale redundancy for substitutions only
statement: For1<=t<=min(floor(n/4),floor(sqrt(n))), choose m=ceil(log2(n+1)),N=2^m-1. Standard binary BCH designed distance2t+1 has <=mt parity bits. Shorten to length n: distance persists and dimension>=n-mt; if that lower bound is negative use a singleton. Since t<=sqrt(n), mt<=t(log2 n+2)<=2t log2(n/t)+2t. Established finite-field/BCH construction, shortening, encoding, syndromes and bounded-distance decoding have uniform polynomial BIT complexity with degree independent of growing t. This covers substitutions with known positions, not insertions/deletions or the full mixed-edit target.

Randomized document-exchange guarantees for words independent of sketch randomness do not automatically give a single fixed adversarial binary code; deterministic conversion’s extra log(n/t) is retained. Existing fixed-t affine/counting/candidate-decoding machinery is mature imported capital, counted once. No new impact grade, practical code or full negative is assigned. Every known/unknown source/access/transfer hold remains. Hypothetical compressed counts and whole-coset reconstruction are SUFFICIENT, not proven necessary. Whole-coset off-promise recovery may be stronger than a code decoder needs; pointwise isolation is stronger than codebook distance. Standard BCH is substitutions only. costs: The explicit family has M=sum_(d=0..t,s=0..min(n-d,2t-2d)) binom(n,d)^2*2^d*binom(n-d,s) maps, including harmless duplicates/fixed-point overcounts. Prefix selection takes b exact count/comparison calls instead of2^b calls, but EACH count still costs O(M*poly(n)) with integer lengths O(n+logM). Hash construction, map counting and candidate decoding remain n^O(t) in the established fixed-t source. No oracle, hidden preprocessing or polynomial exponent independent of t is obtained. Capital performs no enumeration, code construction or decoding run.
